item.title: Clever cow scratches where it itches
item.description: A “pet cow” named Veronika can scratch her own back with a broomstick when she has an itch. Researchers told The New York Times this is the first recorded case of a cow using tools.

item.title: Steenhuisen hits back at industry groups over threatened FMD vaccine court action
item.description: The Minister of Agriculture, John Steenhuisen, and the Department of Agriculture have pushed back strongly against the Southern African Agri Initiative (Saai), Sakeliga and Free State Agriculture, as well as related social media campaigns, following a threatening legal letter from the organisations demanding that livestock owners be allowed to privately procure and administer vaccines.

item.title: Farmers must adapt to new climate reality as weather patterns shift
item.description: Specialist agricultural meteorologist Johan van den Berg brought a crucial scientific perspective to the Nedbank Agriculture Webinar held on 28 January, bridging the gap between global climate science and practical farming decisions.

item.title: Beyond the price tag: What Puma the Boer goat can teach us about trust, genetics and the real value of livestock
item.description: The sale of Puma, a Boer goat, for R30 000 didn’t stir much controversy outside of those specifically interested in Boer goat genetics. Although top Boer goat genetics can fetch prices in the six-figure range, the sale of Puma for R30 000 may have been viewed as a subpar deal.

item.title: From our editor: The world is watching – Why unity matters in SA’s FMD fight
item.description: I recently spent part of a morning with a group of French tourists who wanted to visit a farm owned by a black farmer. As African Farming, we were approached by their tour guide to help identify a suitable farm close to Gauteng, allowing the group to remain near other activities on their itinerary.

item.title: Biosecurity, trade disruptions and climate variability defined SA agriculture in 2025
item.description: During the Nedbank Agriculture Webinar on 28 January, Dr Tracy Davids delivered a comprehensive analysis of South African agriculture’s performance in 2025, revealing a sector that successfully navigated from crisis to recovery while confronting new challenges. As executive director of Commodity Markets and Foresight at the Bureau for Food and Agricultural Policy, her insights provided a crucial perspective on the industry’s resilience and emerging concerns.

item.title: FMD | Free State man arrested for refusing inspection
item.description: A Free State man has been arrested after allegedly refusing to grant state officials access to his property to conduct a foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) inspection.
